_runtime_state_sprites_note: Runtime state sprites. NOT palette entries and NOT placeable — they are wired directly in src_scroll/electricity.js and editor/renderer.js via hardcoded getImage() paths, so they need no manifest entry to function. Kept here for the anchor/frame documentation only. Anything listed in `assets[]` renders as a clickable cell in the Builder asset browser regardless of generation.eligible — that flag controls procedural generation, not palette visibility. Do not move these back into `assets[]`.
